title: Result revisions and correction
purpose: Inspect one requested test’s complete result revision trail and enter an initial observation, correction or reanalysis without rewriting prior observations.
summary: See every revision of one test's result, and enter a first result, a correction or a reanalysis. Earlier revisions are never changed.

tasks.title: Enter the first result
steps: Fill in the result, reporting limit, dilution and analysis start.
Select [[Enter result]]. It is saved as entered; submit it for review from the batch.

tasks.title: Correct a returned or approved result
steps: Explain why in [[Reason for correction or reanalysis]] and select [[Correct result]].

tasks.title: Check the preservation evidence
steps: Select [[Preservation findings and lab disposition]] in the header.

good_to_know: A correction adds a new revision. Approved and returned revisions stay as they were, and issued reports are not changed.
While the latest revision awaits review, it cannot be corrected. A reviewer must decide it first.
Each revision keeps the qualifiers, method and reporting limit it was entered with.
A sample held or rejected at receipt cannot take new results.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: These are staff pages. Active users with an application staff role can read them; client accounts cannot. Analysts perform result entry and batch work, reviewers decide results, and administrators maintain configuration. Administrators also have operational analyst and reviewer access, but independence rules still apply. Superuser status alone does not grant an application role.

items.label: Sample
items.description: Lab ID opens the sample receipt/custody record.

items.label: Method
items.description: Current requested method/version; each revision separately preserves the method used at entry.

items.label: Client / project
items.description: Client and project from the sample’s order.

items.label: Preservation findings and lab disposition
items.description: Open the requested test’s preservation evidence and attributed lab assessment.

items.label: Batch
items.description: Breadcrumb opens the currently assigned batch; revision Method links may lead to older batches after reanalysis.

items.label: Revision
items.description: Sequential revision number, newest first, and its recorded status. No result entered yet means this requested test has no observations.

items.label: Result as supplied
items.description: Original decimal text or ND and frozen unit. ND is displayed with its applied reporting-limit threshold and is stored separately from numeric zero.

items.label: Weight basis / supplied solids
items.description: Soil basis and any supplied percent solids/reference. Older observations with unrecorded basis remain identified as such; no basis or conversion is invented.

items.label: Reporting limit applied
items.description: Exact per-observation limit with unit and method reporting limit captured at entry when present.

items.label: Dilution factor
items.description: Actual dilution recorded for this revision.

items.label: Qualifiers
items.description: Code and meaning captured with the revision, or none. Later configuration changes do not reinterpret these snapshots.

items.label: Analysis start
items.description: Recorded analysis event with laboratory-local display and zone.

items.label: Preparation
items.description: Explicit preparation batch/aliquot and its frozen start, or Independent preparation not recorded. A legacy combined-batch start can be shown separately and is not treated as an independent aliquot.

items.label: Method
items.description: Frozen method code/version and batch where this revision was entered.

items.label: Holding time
items.description: Overall entry-time evaluation plus the name, status, deadline and detail of each clock that applied to this analyte (its own rule where one was configured, otherwise the method’s). An end exactly at deadline meets the rule. Missing required events or reversed chronology are Not evaluable; no applicable active rule gives No holding rule.

items.label: Entered
items.description: Entering actor/time, manual or import source and filename/row detail for imported entries.

items.label: Submitted
items.description: Submitting actor/time, when submitted. A submitter cannot independently review this revision.

items.label: Approved / Returned
items.description: Review actor/time and review note once decided.

items.label: Reason for this revision
items.description: Correction/reanalysis reason, including an automatic draft-revision reason when applicable.

items.label: Comments
items.description: Optional text retained with this revision.

items.label: QC evidence relied on at approval
items.description: Expand the approval snapshot of analytical and linked preparation QC measurements, evaluations and disposition evidence. These frozen values record what approval relied on; current release gates may also recheck today’s relevant state.

items.label: Prepared aliquot
items.description: Optional unless required by current test configuration. Initially the latest revision’s aliquot when present. Choose the same physical aliquot for repeat analysis or a new one for re-preparation; labels/timestamps do not infer identity.

items.label: Result
items.description: Required supplied number or ND. The form does not prefill the earlier observation.

items.label: Reporting limit applied
items.description: Required positive per-result limit; defaults to the current test definition’s limit when configured, not the prior revision’s applied limit.

items.label: Dilution factor
items.description: Required; initially 1.

items.label: Qualifiers
items.description: Active codes separated by commas, spaces or semicolons; unknown/inactive codes are rejected.

items.label: Analysis start
items.description: Required laboratory-local date/time for the actual analysis.

items.label: Result basis
items.description: For soil only: Wet weight or Dry weight is required. New soil observations cannot use Not applicable.

items.label: Percent solids
items.description: Optional exact supplied percentage from 0 through 100.

items.label: Solids source reference
items.description: Required with supplied percent solids, at most 240 characters; cannot be supplied without a percentage.

items.label: Comments
items.description: Optional revision comments.

items.label: Reason for correction or reanalysis
items.description: Required for approved or returned work. A draft replacement with a blank reason is saved with Entry revised before submission. Earlier revisions are kept.

sections.title: Exact results and chronology
paragraphs: Use a plain decimal number, optionally signed or in scientific notation, or ND (case-insensitive) for a non-detect. Zero is a detected numeric observation, never an inferred non-detect. Comparison symbols, units, thousands separators and values needing rounding are rejected. Result text is limited to 60 characters; numeric observations support 14 integer digits and 10 decimal places.

Reporting limit must be positive. Dilution must be positive with at most four decimal places and at most ten integer digits. A detected value below its applied reporting limit needs at least one active qualifier or must be entered as ND where appropriate; the application does not choose that interpretation for you. Units come from the test; nothing is converted.

Analysis cannot precede sample receipt or applicable preparation, and cannot be more than two minutes ahead of the current time. Preparation cannot precede collection, including composite end. Local form times use the deployment’s laboratory time zone; ambiguous/nonexistent daylight-saving local times are rejected.

For soil, choose Wet weight or Dry weight for every new observation. Enter the final result and reporting limit on that same basis; no conversion is performed. Percent solids is optional exact supplied data between 0 and 100 inclusive, and requires its source reference. A reference without percent solids is invalid. Nonsoil results use Not applicable and reject supplied solids metadata.

An active independent preparation requirement needs an explicit available aliquot for this sample/test, matrix and required preparation method/version. It must have a recorded start, and analysis cannot precede completion when recorded, otherwise start. Choosing the same aliquot means repeat analysis; choosing a new physical aliquot means re-preparation. No identity is inferred from a legacy batch timestamp.

items.label: Enter result
items.description: Analysts can enter a first observation once the test is assigned to an analytical batch. Saves a new entered revision; it does not submit.

items.label: Correct result
items.description: Analysts create a new entered revision. A prior draft becomes Superseded; prior approved/returned revisions stay intact. Current result state becomes Entered and the new revision needs submission and independent review. Existing issued report versions remain unchanged.

items.label: Awaiting review
items.description: The correction form is unavailable while the latest revision is submitted. A reviewer must decide it before a new entry; current server state is rechecked when saving.

items.label: History
items.description: Attributed audit events for all this result’s revisions, with action, time, actor and reason. No events recorded is shown when none exist.

sections.title: Errors and next steps
paragraphs: Receipt Hold or Reject blocks new entry. Invalid fields remain on the form. A changed batch/preparation dependency requires reload and retry against current records. A submitted revision cannot be replaced even by an analyst/reviewer combination. After saving, return to the current batch, inspect the entered revision and submit it. Closed membership does not prevent correction or entry.
